title: COSCIENS Biopharma Announces Appointment of Pierre Labbé as Director
description: COSCIENS Biopharma Inc. announced the appointment of Pierre Labbé to its board of directors and as Chair of the Company's Audit Committee, effective today. Mr. Labbé has over 30 years of financial leadership experience and will bring his expertise to COSCIENS as it continues to pursue its strategic direction.

title: COSCIENS Biopharma Inc. Provides Corporate Update and Highlights Pipeline Prioritization
description: COSCIENS Biopharma is focusing on developing and commercializing natural-based products for health and wellness, including cosmeceuticals, nutraceuticals, and pharmaceuticals. The company has streamlined operations and prioritized its pipeline, with key updates on product development and the discontinuation of its macimorelin program for childhood growth hormone deficiency.
